overview: AnimPolish 2.0.0 is a top-to-bottom overhaul with new tools, substantial performance boosts, deeper versions of every existing tool, stability improvements, and a brand new UI. Tested in Maya 2024+, but may be compatible in 2022+.
features: Sticky Mod 2: Sticky Mod is built in, with mirror, copy, attach, aim, naming, and a list of every Sticky Mod in the scene.
Smear: Drag a mesh behind itself on fast moves, keyed by hand or turned on automatically by speed.
Bake-n-Blend: Bake heavy polished meshes to a cache and blend it back on, for fast playback.
Deformer Overview: See every deformer on every mesh in stack order, and select, mute, reorder, or delete them from one list.
Weights Menu: Paint, flood, smooth, invert, mirror, copy, paste, import, and export weights for any AnimPolish deformer.
Local Sculpts: Sculpts can follow the surface as it turns, like a fix riding along a forearm, in Maya 2025 and up.
Sculpt Timing: Set Blend In, Hold, and Blend Out frames, and pick the key curve.
Blend Sculpt: While sculpting, blend toward the mesh before this sculpt, the previous or next sculpt, or a mirror of the current one.
Sculpt Utilities: Mirror sculpts, move them back to the top of the stack, and export or import them with their keys.
Subdue Modes: Soften motion, remove one or two frame pops, or both, over a set frame range with eased blends.
Re-Evaluate: Rebuild Subdue, Smear, and Iron from new animation while keeping their painted weights, keys, and names.
Baked Iron: A baked smoothing mode that plays back fast, with a settable number of iterations.
Fast Caching: Export caches without normals for fast playback, and bring shaders back with every import.
More Maya Deformers: Tension, Solidify, Lattice, Shrink Wrap, Wire, Jiggle, and more are one click away in the Utilities menu.
Settings: Adjust UI scale, fonts, colors, layout, and more, and share your settings as a file.
Docking: Dock the window to either side of Maya, and it reopens the way you left it.
Tooltips and Help: Every control has a tooltip, each tool has a Help section, and there's a Quick Tips window.
Update Alerts: Find out when a new version is out, with its patch notes.
Studio Setup: Studios can lock settings for everyone and run AnimPolish from a shared, read-only install.
fixes: Cache Swapping: Swap Version really loads the new cache now, and keeps the sculpts and shaders on it.
Stable Subdue: Subdue no longer risks crashing Maya on dense meshes.
Separate Scene Caches: Each scene keeps its own cache folder, so shots in a shared project don't overwrite each other.
